headings.scale: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl for Hero; text-2xl to 4xl for sections
headings.style: tracking-tight, leading-none, varied weights (font-light vs font-bold for contrast)

body.scale: text-base for main text, text-sm for dashboard dense areas

colors.primary: Sage Green (#8A9A5B) for main CTAs, active states
colors.neutral: Tinted greys with a touch of warm orange or olive, NEVER pure #000000 or #808080. Dark text: #1A1F16
colors.backgrounds: bg-[#FDFDF9] for main pages, bg-white for cards with 1px border. Do not use full-screen gradients.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboards: Flat Solid surfaces instead of Glass. Use warm solid backgrounds with subtle borders (border-[#E5E7E1]). No heavy shadows.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: border border-black/5 or border-[#E5E7E1], rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl. Flat background, hover state with slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-sm.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Solid Background or highly saturated blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FDFDF9]/80) with a hard bottom border. NO fully transparent headers over content.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
grids_and_layouts.marketing: The Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetry, Visual Tension. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to gap-12.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements, click/press states, focus states.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NEVER use transition: all.
motion.animations: Staggered entrance animations for lists and grids. Micro-animations for feedback.

accessibility.contrast: APCA contrast standards. Normal text min 4.5:1. Never gray-on-gray.
accessibility.interactive: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-sage-700 hover:text-white). Focus states must have higher contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

components.strategy: Dashboards/Apps use Shadcn components heavily customized. Marketing pages use Custom HTML/Tailwind for asymmetry.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn chart components for steps, heart rate, sleep. Accessible color-blind-friendly palettes.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Overlap input borders subtly.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or smooth rounded-xl. Primary color for main CTA only.

3d_libraries.strategy: Minimal 3D for clinical health apps. If needed for a specific product showcase (store), use Framer Motion for simple transitions or 2.5D layer effects. Keep data fast and performant using Recharts.

media.images: Real photos representing health, fitness, and organic products. Max height 80vh on mobile. Images should have subjects.
media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react for Duotone weight (premium look) or lucide-react for standard interfaces.

hero_smartwatch.description: Person wearing a smartwatch to track daily health records, use for hero or dashboard top section.

lifestyle.description: Fitness setup (dumbbells, protein shake) representing health and wellness tracking.

product_mockup.description: Clear supplement bottle on green background, use in the Store / E-commerce section.

user_avatar.description: Smiling person avatar for the profile/dashboard header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all these styles using Tailwind CSS in .js files.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions, rely on customized Shadcn UI.
Create a robust frontend routing structure for the Dashboard, Store, AI Coach, and Profile.
Include a data-testid on every interactive element (button, link, input).
Ensure 'transition: all' is avoided in Tailwind or custom CSS.
For the E-commerce checkout flow, bridge the artful presentation with reliable UX for transactions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' layouts. Follow the generous spacing and varied typography scales.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally or locally, it breaks layout transforms.
Never center-align the main App container.
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp-edged buttons with interaction animations.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (like robot/brain) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Use the exact image URLs provided, never use generic placeholders.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, properly customized.
